git add src/cost/mod.rs src/telemetry/mod.rs src/worker/mod.rs && git commit -m "feat(needle-bb5b32f3): emit needle.model.provider as OTLP attribute

Add provider to EffortData struct and EffortRecorded event to enable
per-record provider tracking in OTLP log exports.

Resource layer was already complete:
- build_resource() accepts provider and adds needle.model.provider
- worker_telemetry_identity() extracts provider from default adapter
- Provider flows through OtlpSink initialization

Per-record layer was already complete:
- emit_log() reads provider from event.data and adds as record attribute

New implementation adds provider to EffortRecorded event:
- EffortData: Add provider: Option<String> field
- EventKind::EffortRecorded: Add provider field
- to_data(): Include provider in JSON output
- EffortRecorded emission: Pass provider from effort data
- All EffortData construction sites: Initialize provider to None

This completes the dual-layer pattern from ADR-016: resource layer
carries the configured default adapter's provider, while the record
layer carries the actually-dispatched adapter's provider, which can
differ when routing rules select a non-default adapter.

Acceptance: OTLP log records now carry needle.model.provider with the
adapter's declared provider string (e.g. \"anthropic\", \"openai\"),
or are absent when the adapter declares no provider (None)."
